name: web-neo-brutalist-accordion-with-blue-header-and-hard-shadow
title: Single open accordion with a cornflower blue header, black outline and hard offset shadow, asking 'Is it accessible?'
whatItIs: A white frame with one accordion item: a cornflower blue header bar with a bold question and an up chevron, a white body with a one-line answer, a thick black outline and a solid black shadow at the bottom right.
whatItMeans: Bold and tactile; thick outlines and a hard shadow make a small component feel like a sticker.
techniques: Use a coloured header and white body.

vocabulary.definition: A solid unblurred shadow beside an element.
An accordion title bar filled with a colour.
A thick black outline around a component.
A style of thick borders, hard shadows and flat colour.
